RecipeDef.label: reprocess replicator blocks
RecipeDef.description: Thermally and mechanically disrupt ten loose Replicator Blocks until their self-organizing structure is inert, recovering a small amount of ordinary steel. The blocks are consumed permanently; this is a disposal route, not an analysis or containment shortcut.

RecipeDef.label: destroy replicator core fragment
RecipeDef.description: Irreversibly melt a recovered Replicator command-lattice fragment, sacrificing the reusable control substrate and recovering a little inert steel. This deliberately removes the fragment from future Sovereign Neural Lattice or suppression-system use.
